This document 
outlines the testing procedure for start up Control System for the gas turbine 
at the locations: Talkha GT, Hurgada, Sharm Al-Shaikh, and Port Said GT Power Stations.

Components : SSKC, SGDD, VCE METER, Start up 
 indicating light.

The first draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour and tested by eng. Magdy Saad El Khamesy, at date 2/6/2003 ,reviewed by eng. Abd 
El-Monem El-Emam at EDEPC, accepted by general director eng. Yousry Ahmed Abd El-Maksoud 
and approved by eng. Mostafa Abdel Hameed Allam: Head Sector of Talkha Power 
Station.

This document was updated at Port Said by adding 
Characteristics "C/CS" curve to the document at 20Nov 2004.

The first draft is updated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour , tested by eng. Eman El Bastawesy at date 11/2/2009 ,Reviewed by EDEPC 
quality control eng. Adel Elnagar , Accepted by general director eng. Mamdouh 
El-saeid Anber ,and approved by eng.Farouk awad head sector of Talkha Power 
Plant .

Wear your 
 safety helmet, shoes .... etc

 With freq. response of 10 Hz to 20 Khz, accuracy 0.01 V

 With freq. response of 10 Hz to 20 Khz, accuracy 0.01 V

Check the Fire VCE value not lower than "Warm-up" VCE. 
Adjust "Warm-up" pot. full CCW to prevent interaction.
Connect voltmeter to " VCE " pin 24 of SSKC (H07 R13) and Acom (G01R02)
Depress "Fire " (PB-5) and read the value if different calibrator used.
Adjust pot. R102 to set " Fire " VCE to value as given in the control spec.setting

items:
Check the Fire VCE value not lower than "Warm-up" VCE. 
Adjust "Warm-up" pot. full CCW to prevent interaction.
Connect voltmeter to " VCE " pin 24 of SSKC (H07 R13) and Acom (G01R02)
Depress "Fire " (PB-5) and read the value if different calibrator used.
Adjust pot. R102 to set " Fire " VCE to value as given in the control spec.setting
Depress " WU " (PB - 3) and check the correct value

Adjust pot R101 to set " Warm-up " VCE value as given in the spec, 
 control - cont sys settings

Depress " ACC " (PB - 1) and hold for 3 minutes. check to see that VCE 
 increases to accelerate limit on 60 SEC time constant. (reaches limit in 3 
 minutes)

After VCE has reached accelerate limit adjust pot R100 to set "Accel limit" 
 VCE as given in the control spec. settings

sections.text:
Notes: 
If " TCC " (PB-2) is depressed 
the one minute time constant is reduced

" 
Accelerate " VCE level will be reached in approximately 20 seconds

items: Depress " MAX " (PB-6)

Set VCE to 10 volts. Adjust VCE meter using test voltmeter and " MAX " 
 pushbutton, 10 volts

Adjust pot R 106 to set " MAX " VCE to value as given in the control spec. 
 setting
Depress " Min " (PB - 4)

Adjust pot R 104 to set " MIN " VCE to the value given in the control spec. - 
 setting

Jumper " NOTLCDA-4 " (SW6R34) to acom (GOIR 02) to put "0" on pin 30 of SSKC 
 and remove VCE clamp

Jumper to drop out the " Firing " SLEH element and put "0" on pin 28 of SSKC 
 check value is " fire " VCE

Jumper to pick up the " 28 FDX " SLEH element and put "0" on pin 18 of SSKC 
 after 2 SEC check value is " Warm-up " VCE

Jumper to pick up the "2WX" SLEH element and put "0" on pin 6 of SSKC check 
 that VCE accelerates on a one minute time constant

Rotate " MAN VCE " knob through its range verify that " speed control abnormal 
 " light energizes with a slight clockwise movement from off. Return knob to 
 off.

Remove jumper to drop out the firing SLEH element and check that VCE goes to 
 zero.
Remove all jumpers and test equipment.

Instrument & Control | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the testing procedure for start up Control System for the gas turbine 
at the locations: Talkha GT, Hurgada, Sharm Al-Shaikh, and Port Said GT Power Stations.
The calibrated cards: SSKC - SGDD,
Components : SSKC, SGDD, VCE METER, Start up 
 indicating light.
The first draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour and tested by eng. Magdy Saad El Khamesy, at date 2/6/2003 ,reviewed by eng. Abd 
El-Monem El-Emam at EDEPC, accepted by general director eng. Yousry Ahmed Abd El-Maksoud 
and approved by eng. Mostafa Abdel Hameed Allam: Head Sector of Talkha Power 
Station.
This document was updated at Port Said by adding 
Characteristics "C/CS" curve to the document at 20Nov 2004.
The first draft is updated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour , tested by eng. Eman El Bastawesy at date 11/2/2009 ,Reviewed by EDEPC 
quality control eng. Adel Elnagar , Accepted by general director eng. Mamdouh 
El-saeid Anber ,and approved by eng.Farouk awad head sector of Talkha Power 
Plant .
Safety Precautions
Turbine shutdown.
Work order 
 must be issued.
Wear your 
 safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Tools and Equipment
Digital voltmeter, 0-150 VDC 0-500 VAC,
 With freq. response of 10 Hz to 20 Khz, accuracy 0.01 V
Calibrator set cat no. IC 4988A100AA
Digital voltmeter, 0-150 VDC 0-500 VAC,
 With freq. response of 10 Hz to 20 Khz, accuracy 0.01 V
Calibrator set cat no. IC 4988A100AA
Work to be Carried Out
Fire VCE
Check the Fire VCE value not lower than "Warm-up" VCE. 
Adjust "Warm-up" pot. full CCW to prevent interaction.
Connect voltmeter to " VCE " pin 24 of SSKC (H07 R13) and Acom (G01R02)
Depress "Fire " (PB-5) and read the value if different calibrator used.
Adjust pot. R102 to set " Fire " VCE to value as given in the control spec.setting
Check the Fire VCE value not lower than "Warm-up" VCE. 
Adjust "Warm-up" pot. full CCW to prevent interaction.
Connect voltmeter to " VCE " pin 24 of SSKC (H07 R13) and Acom (G01R02)
Depress "Fire " (PB-5) and read the value if different calibrator used.
Adjust pot. R102 to set " Fire " VCE to value as given in the control spec.setting
" Warm - up " VCE
Depress " WU " (PB - 3) and check the correct value
Adjust pot R101 to set " Warm-up " VCE value as given in the spec, 
 control - cont sys settings
" Accelerate " VCE
Depress " ACC " (PB - 1) and hold for 3 minutes. check to see that VCE 
 increases to accelerate limit on 60 SEC time constant. (reaches limit in 3 
 minutes)
After VCE has reached accelerate limit adjust pot R100 to set "Accel limit" 
 VCE as given in the control spec. settings
Notes: 
If " TCC " (PB-2) is depressed 
the one minute time constant is reduced
" 
Accelerate " VCE level will be reached in approximately 20 seconds
" Maximum " VCE
Depress " MAX " (PB-6)
Set VCE to 10 volts. Adjust VCE meter using test voltmeter and " MAX " 
 pushbutton, 10 volts
Adjust pot R 106 to set " MAX " VCE to value as given in the control spec. 
 setting
Minimum " VCE "
Depress " Min " (PB - 4)
Adjust pot R 104 to set " MIN " VCE to the value given in the control spec. - 
 setting
Recheck of VCE Setting
Jumper " NOTLCDA-4 " (SW6R34) to acom (GOIR 02) to put "0" on pin 30 of SSKC 
 and remove VCE clamp
Jumper to drop out the " Firing " SLEH element and put "0" on pin 28 of SSKC 
 check value is " fire " VCE
Jumper to pick up the " 28 FDX " SLEH element and put "0" on pin 18 of SSKC 
 after 2 SEC check value is " Warm-up " VCE
Jumper to pick up the "2WX" SLEH element and put "0" on pin 6 of SSKC check 
 that VCE accelerates on a one minute time constant
Rotate " MAN VCE " knob through its range verify that " speed control abnormal 
 " light energizes with a slight clockwise movement from off. Return knob to 
 off.
Remove jumper to drop out the firing SLEH element and check that VCE goes to 
 zero.
Remove all jumpers and test equipment.
